propositions: GitHub Actions workflow `name:` fields use non-descriptive lowercase values (test, release, optionality, external-integration, verify-identity, terraform-drift, mirror-guard, gerrit-verify) making the Actions tab hard to scan
Inconsistent file extensions across workflows (.yaml and .yml coexist; ecosystem standard is .yml only)
eval.yml has filename/name mismatch (filename eval.yml but name: prompt-eval) and eval-plan-review-container.yml is closed scaffolding for story da34 that should be deleted

Standardize by adopting Title Case `name:` values per researched convention, rename files to lowercase-with-hyphens.yml format (except gerrit-verify.yaml and release.yml which have external dependencies), and update all in-repo references
All workflow-pinning tests and make lint (actionlint) must pass after the naming and reference changes
